device.notes: Send + reply-to-last monitor. Paste the BotFather bot token in Secret/Token (never logged). Set chat_id to the destination chat (numeric id or @channel). Host field unused — traffic always goes to api.telegram.org over HTTPS. Set NIC face to Venue / outbound so egress uses the room internet NIC (AV face also works on single-NIC hosts). message.send value = plain text (parse_mode off); on success Relay remembers that message_id in process memory. Feedback message.lastReply / message.replied short-poll getUpdates and become true / carry text only when an update is a reply to that last send in the configured chat_id (other chats and non-replies ignored). Offset tracked carefully; no webhook. Reply text is never executed as shell or macros — inbound poll limited to reply-to-last-send, not a general command channel (allowlisted macros need a later MR). Fail-closed if token or chat_id missing. Authenticate runs getMe.

pairing.userPrompt: Paste BotFather token into Secret/Token, set chat_id, prefer NIC face Venue/outbound, then Authenticate (getMe).
